remarks: 150' x 48' LOT in Downtown Edmonton! Priced to SELL! This piece of land offers incredible potential for development. The site is zoned for High Density Residential (HDR), allowing, tentatively, for a building with 14 - 15 units. Any plans for a high rise with more units are subject to zoning approval. The site provides breathtaking views of the Edmonton River Valley and the Alberta Legislature. Located just minutes from MacEwan University, this prime location is close to shopping, transit, and Jasper Ave. This opportunity won’t last long at this price! (id:67522)
